summary.intent: Execute plan 48-04 (REQ-3 web) to re-route shared folder write operations through SDK client methods and feed projection state exclusively from server events, then launch plan 48-06 (REQ-4 web) for ECIES encryption of itemName in ShareDialog.
summary.outcome: 48-04 completed: write hook re-routed to SDK client methods (reads nothing back), shared folder refs are now single-writer via `sharedFolder:updated` subscription, seeded at every depth. Typecheck, lint, and 6 unit tests all green. 48-06 was launched but had not completed when the transcript ended.

repo: Shared folder projection state (folderChildrenRef, sequenceNumberRef) must be written by exactly one path — the `sharedFolder:updated` event subscription — to eliminate web/SDK drift.

`sharedFolderTree` is keyed by shareId but each depth has a distinct ipnsName/folderKey/IPNS key/sequence, so `loadSharedFolder` must be re-invoked on share-enter, subfolder-enter, navigateUp, and navigateToBreadcrumb for write shares.
`@cipherbox/web` vitest runs in `node` environment, so shared projection logic must be framework-agnostic (no React hooks) to be testable.
The SDK dist (`sdk-core` → `sdk`) must be rebuilt before running web type checks or tests, as web depends on the compiled SDK output.
The 30s poller's `refreshFolderContents` updates display refs but does NOT re-seed the SDK, leaving a residual desync risk if a poll-then-write occurs without intervening navigation.

code.finding: All five handlers now call `getSdkClient().<sharedMethod>(currentShareId, args)` with no read-back. Removed withConflictRetry, resyncSharedFolder, buildSharedWriteContext, freshCtx, and four write-back lines per handler. withRevocationGuard (403 → read-only) retained. Params slimmed.
`sharedFolder:updated` subscription is now the sole writer of folderChildrenRef/sequenceNumberRef + setters, filtered on active shareId read via currentShareIdRef at event time.
`loadSharedFolder` is re-invoked on share-enter, subfolder-enter, navigateUp, and navigateToBreadcrumb (write shares only) to seed the SDK at every depth.
New framework-agnostic module holding `seedSharedFolder` and `subscribeSharedFolderProjection` — extracted to be node-testable under vitest node env.
6 tests covering per-share isolation, reads-nothing-back, file-only re-resolve, and unsubscribe behavior.

workflow: UAT checkpoints (human-verify tasks) are deferred to the end-of-phase web-e2e run rather than blocking individual plan execution.
Acceptance greps (asserting absence of old patterns like `folderChildrenRef.current =` and `withConflictRetry`) are used alongside positive presence checks as lightweight CI-equivalent gates.
Phase execution follows a fixed post-completion pipeline: rebuild dist → full web-e2e dispatch → /simplify → /gsd:validate-phase → CodeRabbit → /security:review → re-sign unsigned commits → open PR.

friction: SDK dist must be manually rebuilt before web checks — an ordering dependency that could silently produce false-positive type errors if skipped.
Task 4 UAT (write-share recipient operations) could not be verified inline and was deferred, leaving the end-to-end correctness of the write path unconfirmed until web-e2e runs.
open_items: Plan 48-06 (REQ-4 web): ECIES wrap of `itemName` in ShareDialog using recipient pubkey, decrypt-for-display, and A2 lazy backfill of legacy plaintext items.

Task 4 UAT: upload / mkdir / rename / edit-content / delete in a write-share must reflect immediately and persist after reload with no console errors or stale-sequence 409 loops — delegated to web-e2e shared-folder spec.

Residual desync risk: 30s poller updates display refs but does not re-seed the SDK; a poll-then-write without intervening navigation relies on publishWithCas self-correcting the sequence — needs explicit coverage in web-e2e.
Post-phase pipeline pending: rebuild dist, full web-e2e dispatch, /simplify, /gsd:validate-phase 48, CodeRabbit review, /security:review, re-sign all unsigned commits, open PR.
